title: May: Finding Myself in Unusual Places
coreMove: Buying less pays off when the saved money and attention are deliberately spent on people, places, rest, and agency, not when restraint becomes another display.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose old triggers arrive through ordinary media
exampleSpecs.stakes: use a softened cue before it becomes a purchase loop
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show book lists and candle advertisements losing their old pull in May

exampleSpecs.audience: workers learning to spend saved resources on recovery and mobility
exampleSpecs.stakes: let travel serve capacity rather than status
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show the experience dividend as money, time, and attention redirected into travel and rest

exampleSpecs.audience: adults trying to keep family steadiness during change
exampleSpecs.stakes: let acceptance calm the emotional field without denying grief
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show siblings in Victoria revisiting the parents divorce and finding survivable acceptance

exampleSpecs.audience: readers testing whether travel is connection or consumption
exampleSpecs.stakes: value the lived stop over the souvenir version of the stop
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show New York, Boston, food, historic sites, and spontaneous choices becoming the real return

exampleSpecs.audience: workers waiting for a real opening after a prepared exit plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: recognize opportunity without pretending preparation was optional
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show a May client email making freelance work viable enough to give notice

exampleSpecs.audience: minimalists tempted to turn experiences into proof
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep the trip tied to values instead of performance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show the experience dividend as more than owning fewer things or preferring travel
